name: independent-redteam-round-9
description: Independent red-team round 9: ~100 adversarial and hard-negative samples across the eleven benchmarked tools, written against the frozen v0.48.0 detectors without reading tool source, rule lists, tests, prior red-team fixtures (including round 8), the private dev set, or the v0.48.0 diff. Techniques come from published 2026 research and classes that round 8 did not use. See SOURCES.md.
method: README and runner interface only; no detector source, tests, prior samples, or v0.48 diff. Scored once; detectors unchanged.
positive_definition: A sample is flagged when the assigned tool reports at least one finding of severity low, medium, high, or critical. Info-level inventory rules do not count.
